facts.fact: The Data Protection Act 2011 mandates a Data Protection Commission, which the article by Letsatsi Lekhooa for Digital Rights Alliance Africa says had still not been established almost fifteen years later.
The article says Lesotho enacted the Data Protection Act in 2011 and that it remains the cornerstone of the data protection framework.
The article says the 2011 Act mandated a Data Protection Commission that has not been established, so the Act cannot be effectively enforced.
The article says Lesotho enacted the Data Protection Act in 2011, which remains the cornerstone of its data protection framework.
The article says Lesotho has signed but not yet ratified the AU Malabo Convention.
The article says the Data Protection Commission mandated by the 2011 Act has not been established and no independent body exists to enforce the law.
